page.title: Your people. Our Island.
page.subtitle: A member campaign, from the email promise to the content and ticket offer behind it.

sections.heading: From member email to guest tickets
sections.text: Follow the steps: system flow, marketing workspace and fan phone stay in sync. Campaign and integrations are illustrative; imagery is from the Islanders' official membership pages. A/B are walkthrough annotations, not fan-facing UI. The 9:41 clock is display-only.

steps.text: **The promotion.** This is the member email from Salesforce Marketing Cloud. The phone shows its actual creative and the campaign link the fan will click.
Click Explore member guest tickets. The member website checks sign-in and membership, then shows the promised guest-access content. Recognition alone is not ticketing authorization.

**Match the content to the page.** The Contentful mockup shows the same official Islanders photo used on the phone. Compare A (headline) and B (button); the destination points to the member ticket offer.
View guest-ticket options leads to the matching Ticketmaster Account Manager offer. Ticketmaster verifies eligibility and supplies inventory and prices; this concept does not simulate checkout.

**Stop the reminder after purchase.** In this simulated outcome, an illustrative integration supplies Ticketmaster's confirmed purchase to Salesforce Marketing Cloud. At the reminder decision, this member matches the Purchased path and exits; a click alone does not qualify.
The same email link opens a sign-in gate when membership is not verified. Preserve the campaign destination so the fan does not have to find the offer again.
After illustrative member verification, return to the original landing page and its guest-ticket CTA. No credentials are collected by this demo.
An old email still points to this campaign, but the offer has ended. Serve the published fallback copy and remove the expired member-offer checkout link.
**Replace the expired promise.** Contentful supplies the fallback headline and button. A and B match the phone; the new destination is regular tickets, with no expired member offer.
The fallback opens regular ticket options. Preserve campaign attribution if appropriate, but carry no expired member entitlement into ticketing.
